one_line_reason: Two clean single-ingredient RCTs of standardized Equisetum arvense extract (900 mg/day) show a real diuretic effect in healthy volunteers and an antihypertensive effect in hypertensive patients versus a diuretic drug comparator.

selected.intervention: standardized dried Equisetum arvense extract (EADE) 900 mg/day oral, vs placebo and vs hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg/day, crossover with washout
selected.why_selected: Clean single-ingredient, dose-stated RCT in healthy (non-patient) volunteers directly testing the diuretic effect horsetail is traditionally marketed for, with a positive, drug-comparable result

selected.population: 58 adults with stage I systemic arterial hypertension
selected.intervention: Equisetum arvense standardized dry extract 900 mg/day oral vs hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg/day, 3 months
selected.primary_outcome: systolic and diastolic blood pressure reduction
selected.why_selected: Single-ingredient RCT with a stated dose showing a significant antihypertensive effect, though in a clinical hypertensive population compared head-to-head against a prescription diuretic

blockers: 35168030 studies diagnosed hypertension patients and benchmarks against a prescription antihypertensive drug (hydrochlorothiazide), which edges toward a medical claim rather than general wellness use

The two silicon-bioavailability trials (34706374, 34389753) establish that Equisetum-derived silicon is absorbed but do not test a health outcome, so they are handed off rather than counted as efficacy

handoff_pmids.note: Pilot RCT in healthy men measuring silicon absorption/pharmacokinetics from Equisetum arvense tea versus low-silicon water; safety/immunological parameters were secondary, not a health-outcome efficacy trial

Crossover bioavailability study comparing relative silicon absorption across three different silicon supplement formulations (one containing Equisetum arvense); a PK/absorption comparison, not an efficacy trial

excluded_pmids.reason: BNO 1030 (Imupret®) is a 7-herb combination (marshmallow, chamomile, horsetail, walnut, yarrow, oak bark, dandelion) for pediatric tonsillitis; not a single-ingredient horsetail exposure
Urox® is a 3-herb combination (Crataeva nurvala, Equisetum arvense, Lindera aggregata) for overactive bladder; combination product, not isolated horsetail
Eviprostat/EVI-F is a 5-ingredient combination (including Equisetum arvense extract) for benign prostatic hyperplasia; combination product
Assonal®PEA combines palmitoylethanolamide (600 mg) with Equisetum arvense (300 mg) for chronic pain; combination product, not isolated horsetail
Topical nail lacquer combining hydroxypropyl chitosan, horsetail extract, and DMSO2 for nail psoriasis; a topical combination product, not an oral supplement
Bedtime Buddy® / Urox® combination herbal product for pediatric nocturnal enuresis; combination product
General narrative review of phytotherapy for upper respiratory/GI infections; horsetail is one of several herbs mentioned, no isolated human trial data given

RCT of a 'horsetail mixture' for rheumatoid arthritis; abstract does not specify whether this is single-ingredient Equisetum or a blend, and the population is a clinical autoimmune-disease population -- too ambiguous on composition to select as clean evidence
